newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures off highs after China excitement.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures off highs after China excitement.

text.p: LIFFE grains last traded up, but well off the day's highs.
Talk of a big wheat loading for China sent a ripple of excitement through the market, taking it to highs.
But much of the gain was scrubbed off in later trading.
Active May wheat last traded 0.80 stg up at 98.00 stg, having seen a high of 98.65 stg. May dominated the volume with 447 out of a total 728 lots traded.

"It all went a bit flat," one trader said. He noted continued shipper buying interest throughout the day and a high level of long liquidation, "selling to new longs really as people built up new positions on this China talk."
The strength of sterling, which rose against other European currencies during the course of the day, was largely ignored, despite its potential effect on the competitivity of UK grains.
The tone in barley was less bullish than wheat, with contracts ending narrowly mixed. Active November barley last traded unchanged at 93.00 stg.
